definitions: Used to indicate that one has strong negative opinions or a lot to say about a particular topic, and would prefer not to begin discussing it.
A phrase used to avoid discussing a topic that the speaker feels strongly about, often negatively, because it would lead to a lengthy or emotional discussion.
examples: Don't get me started on the new office policy.
Oh, don't get me started on traffic in this city.
Don't get me started on his excuses.
synonyms: don't even get me started on
if you get me started on
